name: Recover Destiny Podman
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; timeout 90 sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -u
# Remove only stale commands left by our timed-out maintenance and the probe daemon.
for pid in 898301 898352 898293 884583 124509; do kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; done
sleep 3
ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,args | grep -E '[p]odman|[c]onmon|[h]elmd' | head -60 || true
podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' 2>&1 || true
REMOTE
description: Remove only stale maintenance processes and the accidental helmd probe daemon so Destiny’s Podman runtime can recover.
